claims.statement: Thompson 1980 introduced local feature inversion within a rotated face
claims.limit: mechanism not identified conclusively

claims.statement: 1997 experiment found slower feature orientation judgments when faces inverted
claims.limit: not a measure of IQ or brain health

claims.statement: Thatcher-like effects occur with nonface objects including cars and letter strings
claims.limit: does not prove every category uses identical mechanisms

claims.statement: A uniquely face-specific Thatcher mechanism is established
claims.limit: 2010 study did not see evidence for a unique face-specific mechanism in this task

claims.statement: 2001 rotation task favored gradual loss over sudden shift
claims.limit: task-specific, no universal angle of transition

claims.statement: ERP scalp recordings prove brainwave-audio programs boost focus
claims.limit: unrelated stimulus, outcome and intervention

claims.statement: The Thatcher illusion diagnoses hypnotizability or mental health
claims.limit: none of source studies validated diagnostic use

claims.statement: 2012 Ouija guessing result 65% vs 50% applies to 21 analyzed participants, with computer-selected explicit answers
claims.limit: not a pendulum experiment or universal result

claims.statement: 2017 first experiment analyzed 63 of 80; second 34 of 40, task faster in second
claims.limit: response-criterion bias is task-specific

claims.statement: 2022 changed-procedure pendulum study reproduced 2012 Ouija advantage
claims.limit: summary reports no such replication

claims.statement: Inspire3 publicly lists Zen12, Hypnosis Live and Brainwave Shots
claims.limit: does not establish FV partner approval

offer.disclosure: If you purchase through a verified Final Vestige earning link in the future, we may earn a commission at no additional cost to you. There is no active earning link on this page.

funnel.primary_metric: realized net revenue per 1000 qualified-human sessions
funnel.formula: 1000 * (settled owned-product receipts + cleared affiliate commissions - refunds - fees - chargebacks, all in one stated reporting currency and counted once) / audited qualified-human sessions; missing denominator or settlements => NOT COMPUTABLE. Confirmed paid orders are a separate count, not money.
funnel.privacy: No user email, name, persistent fingerprint or IP in UTM payload. No new script and no new signup list.
